بگو با ایجنت‌ها و ابزارهایی که الان داری: Tell me what you can do with the agents and tools you have right now, with a few short examples.
یک جاب هفتگی بساز که هر دوشنبه صبح خلاصه: Create a weekly job that sends me a summary of last week every Monday morning. Ask me first where to read from and where to send it.
می‌خواهم یک متن یا فایل را خلاصه کنی. او: I want you to summarize a text or file. Ask me which one first, then give me the key points and the action items separately.
کمکم کن یک ایجنت تازه بسازم: اول بپرس قر: Help me create a new agent: ask what it should do, then propose its instructions, its tools, and who should be allowed to call it.
Help me write a short, polite message. Ask who it's for and what it's about first.
کمکم کن کارهای این هفته را اولویت‌بندی ک: Help me prioritize this week's tasks. Take the list from me and suggest a simple plan.
دو گزینه را برایم مقایسه کن. اول بپرس کد: Compare two options for me. Ask which ones and what matters to me, then give a conclusion with sources.
دربارهٔ یک موضوع یک خلاصهٔ یک‌صفحه‌ای بد: Give me a one-page brief on a topic: what we know, what we don't, and a source for each claim. Ask which topic first.
یک ادعا را برایم بسنج. بگو منابع چه می‌گ: Fact-check a claim for me. Tell me what the sources say and how sure you are; keep guesses apart from findings.
یادداشت‌های ذخیره‌شده را مرور کن و بگو چ: Go through the saved notes and tell me what is duplicated, outdated or contradictory.
متنی را که می‌فرستم روان و کوتاه‌تر کن،: Make the text I send clearer and shorter without changing its meaning. Finish with three lines on what changed.
متنی را که می‌فرستم ترجمه کن و لحنش را ح: Translate the text I send and keep its tone. Ask which language first.
یک ایمیل کوتاه بنویس. اول بپرس برای چه ک: Write a short email. Ask who it's for, what it's about and what tone to use first.
این متن را به یک خلاصهٔ پنج‌خطی برای یک: Turn this text into a five-line summary for a busy manager: the outcome first, then the decisions needed.
پیام‌های امروز را مرور کن و فقط چیزهایی: Go through today's messages and tell me only what needs a reply or action from me.
یک یادآوری زمان‌بندی‌شده برایم بساز. اول: Create a scheduled reminder for me. Ask when and what about first.
چیزی را که می‌گویم در یادداشت‌ها نگه دار: Keep what I tell you in your notes so I can ask later — never passwords or tokens.
کمکم کن به یک پیام جواب بدهم. پیام را بخ: Help me reply to a message. Read it, give me a short draft, and send it only when I say so.
وضعیت سیستم‌هایی را که به آن‌ها دسترسی د: Check the systems you can reach and tell me only what affects users.
نگرانم فضای ذخیره‌سازی پر شود. وضعیت را: I'm worried we'll run out of storage. Tell me where we stand and flag anything close to full.
بعد از یک تغییر یا دیپلوی اخیر چیزی خراب: Something broke after a recent change or deploy. Find out what changed and what it affected.
از هشدارهای امروز فقط چیزهایی را بگو که: From today's alerts, tell me only the ones that really affect users or stability.
یک سایت برای کاربر باز نمی‌شود. اول بپرس: A site won't load for a user. Ask which domain first, then tell me whether the problem is at the edge or the origin.
کاربرها نسخهٔ قدیمی سایت را می‌بینند. بگ: Users see an old version of the site. Tell me what to do, and ask for the domain if you need it.
روی یک دامنه هشدار گواهی می‌آید. وضعیت T: A domain shows a certificate warning. Check its TLS; ask which domain first.
چه دامنه‌هایی الان روی CDN هستند؟ فهرست: Which domains are on the CDN right now? Give me a short list.
